speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing vaginal bleeding and abdominal pain; to help me assess the urgency, how many weeks pregnant are you and have you had any fever or history of ectopic pregnancy?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your history of a prior cesarean section, the cessation of contractions, and the onset of severe pain with bleeding, I am highly concerned about placental abruption or uterine rupture. We need to see your fetal heart rate tracing immediately and check if you have passed any membranes. REQUEST TEST: Fetal_Heart_Rate_Tracing; REQUEST TEST: Ultrasound_Abdominal.
